P−1：折回后不动，是否就是原来的空间操作固定了这个点？: P−1: Does returning to the same cell position mean the spatial operation fixes the actual point?
P−1 原胞中的精确轨道与实际位点群: Exact orbits and actual site-symmetry groups in a P−1 primitive cell
先预测一般点 x=(1/5,3/10,2/5) 与半整数点 q=(1/2,0,1: First predict the orbit sizes within one cell for the general point x=(1/5,3/10,2/5) and the half-integer point q=(1/2,0,1/2). Then calculate the stabilizers modulo translations and the operations that fix the actual spatial points. Test the special-position condition with a small, exact displacement.
采用 P−1（空间群2）的原胞分数坐标，原点取一个反演中心，晶格平移为 T={: Use fractional coordinates in a primitive cell of P−1 (space group 2), with an inversion center at the origin. The lattice-translation subgroup is T={ {I|n}:n∈Z³ }.
完整空间群 G={ {εI|n}:ε=±1,n∈Z³ }；实际空间主动作用为 r: The full space group is G={ {εI|n}:ε=±1,n∈Z³ }. Its active action in real space is r′=εr+n; in a product, the operation on the right acts first.
本题的单胞点属于 R³/Z³：每个坐标减去其下取整后折回 [0,1)。有限商群: Cell positions in this exercise belong to R³/Z³. Subtract the floor of each coordinate to wrap it into [0,1). The finite quotient Ḡ=G/T has only two elements, Ē and ī.
模平移稳定子要求 [gr]=[r]；实际位点群 G_r 则要求 gr=r，而非仅: The stabilizer modulo translations requires [gr]=[r]. The actual site-symmetry group G_r requires gr=r, rather than equality up to a lattice vector. Keep these two tests distinct.
全部分数按有理数精确计算；本题不依据接近程度或浮点容差将两个点合并，也不指认 W: Calculate all fractions as exact rational numbers. Do not merge points on the basis of proximity or a floating-point tolerance. This exercise does not assign Wyckoff letters.
对反演，先写 −r，再折回。要找实际固定 r 的反演操作，应解 −r+n=r；其: For inversion, first calculate −r, then wrap it into the cell. To find an inversion operation that fixes the actual point r, solve −r+n=r with an integer vector n.
先明确比较的是哪个群和哪一种点: Specify the group and the meaning of a point
完整 G 是无限群，不能把它的阶当成2。模原胞平移后才得到阶为2的 Ḡ，它作用: The full group G is infinite, so its order is not 2. Taking the quotient by primitive-cell translations gives Ḡ of order 2, acting on equivalence classes of cell positions. Self-check: Are both sides of the orbit–stabilizer relation using the same Ḡ and the same translation subgroup?
反演先给出 (−1/5,−3/10,−2/5)，折回得到 (4/5,7/10,3: Inversion gives (−1/5,−3/10,−2/5), which wraps to (4/5,7/10,3/5). This differs from the original point x, so only Ē preserves [x]. Self-check: Does another inversion followed by wrapping return x? Are there exactly two distinct representatives?
半整数点在有限商群中如何不动: Test a half-integer point in the finite quotient
−q=(−1/2,0,−1/2) 与 q 相差整数向量 (−1,0,−1)，折回: The difference between −q=(−1/2,0,−1/2) and q is the integer vector (−1,0,−1), so they wrap to the same point. Both Ē and ī therefore stabilize [q]. Self-check: Equality modulo translations does not mean that the actual coordinates satisfy −q=q.
找出实际固定 q 的反演操作: Find the inversion operation that fixes the actual point q
解 −q+n=q 得 n=2q=(1,0,1)，所以实际固定 q 的代表应带这个: Solving −q+n=q gives n=2q=(1,0,1). The representative that fixes q must include this integer translation. Self-check: Substitute directly to obtain −q+(1,0,1)=q, then use Seitz multiplication to verify that the operation squares to the actual identity, rather than a nonzero translation. For the general point x, 2x=(2/5,3/5,4/5) is not an integer vector, so no such group element fixes x.
反演在单胞点上不动的充要条件是 2r∈Z³。每个折回坐标只能取0或1/2，所以有: A cell position is fixed by inversion if and only if 2r∈Z³. Each wrapped coordinate must be 0 or 1/2, giving 2³=8 fixed classes. Each forms its own singleton orbit under this finite group; they do not form one eight-point orbit. Self-check: Each point r has its own actual inversion representative {−I|2r}. Equal orbit multiplicities alone do not uniquely identify Wyckoff letters.
r∈{0,1/2}³；固定类数=8；每一类 |Orb|=1，|Stab|=2: r∈{0,1/2}³; number of fixed classes=8; for each class, |Orb|=1 and |Stab|=2
将 q 沿第一坐标移动1/1000，得到 qδ=(501/1000,0,1/2): Displace q by 1/1000 along the first coordinate to obtain qδ=(501/1000,0,1/2). Its inversion image wraps to (499/1000,0,1/2). The two points are exactly distinct, so the orbit again has 2 points and the stabilizer has 1 element. Self-check: Their first coordinates differ by 1/500, and the first coordinate of 2qδ is 501/500, which is not an integer. Moving the point being examined does not change the specified group from P−1 to P1.
一般点 x 的模平移轨道大小为2、稳定子大小为1，实际位点群也只有恒等。q 的模: The general point x has an orbit of size 2 and a stabilizer of size 1 modulo translations; its actual site-symmetry group also contains only the identity. For q, the corresponding sizes are 1 and 2. The inversion in its actual site-symmetry group is {−I|(1,0,1)}, rather than {−I|0}. Each of the eight half-integer fixed classes satisfies 1×2=2; they do not form one eight-point orbit, and multiplicity alone does not assign a Wyckoff letter. The exact perturbation qδ restores a two-point orbit.
实际位点群与模平移稳定子在本题可一一对应，阶相同，但它们的元素不是相同的操作记录: In this example, the actual site-symmetry group and the stabilizer modulo translations correspond one to one and have the same order. Their elements are not recorded as the same spatial operations: a quotient element has many representatives differing by translations, and the representative that fixes the specified actual point must be found separately. Do not mix the infinite G, the finite Ḡ, or different cells in the orbit–stabilizer relation.
哪一个实际空间操作固定 q=(1/2,0,1/2)，而不只是把它送到平移等价的位: Which actual spatial operation fixes q=(1/2,0,1/2), rather than merely sending it to a translation-equivalent position?
第二项给出 −q+(1,0,1)=q；第一项给出−q，实际坐标不等于q；第三项是: The second choice gives −q+(1,0,1)=q. The first gives −q, whose actual coordinates differ from q. The third is a nonzero lattice translation and also fails to fix the actual point.
二色交换与时间反演：相同箭头为何不能代替算符？: Two-color exchange and time reversal: Why are matching arrows not enough?
线性二色置换与自旋1/2反幺正算符的精确比较: An exact comparison of a linear two-color permutation and spin-1/2 time reversal
分别计算普通二色交换P和自旋时间反演Θ对基向量、复振幅及叠加态的作用，检验二次作: Calculate how ordinary two-color exchange P and spin time reversal Θ act on basis vectors, complex amplitudes, and superpositions. Apply each twice, then construct a two-level Hamiltonian that preserves P without being degenerate.
在有序标签基（红，蓝）上，把交换线性延拓为 P=[[0,1],[1,0]]。引入: In the ordered label basis (red, blue), extend exchange linearly as P=[[0,1],[1,0]]. Formal complex amplitudes are introduced to compare maps; the color labels are not identified with electron spin.
在指定自旋基（↑，↓）上沿用本节约定 Θ=−iσyK，σy=[[0,−i],[i: In the specified spin basis (↑,↓), use this lesson's convention Θ=−iσyK, with σy=[[0,−i],[i,0]]. K conjugates each component, so A=−iσy=[[0,−1],[1,0]] and Θψ=Aψ*.
为比较两种矩阵作用，使用各自的有序二元坐标。ψ+=(1,1)/√2，ψc=(1,: Compare the maps using their respective ordered pairs of coordinates. Let ψ+=(1,1)/√2 and ψc=(1,i)/√2, where i is the imaginary unit.
若其他演示写T=+iσyK，它与本题Θ相差整体−1；对照分量时先对齐约定，二次作: If another demonstration writes T=+iσyK, it differs from this exercise's Θ by an overall factor of −1. Align the conventions before comparing components; the result of applying the operator twice is unchanged.
最后的反例取精确无量纲模型H=σx=P。这里比较的是算符约束，不是某个真实材料的: For the final counterexample, use the exact dimensionless model H=σx=P. The comparison concerns operator constraints rather than fitted parameters for a material.
Θ(cψ)=c*Θψ。第二次作用要把第一次的振幅再共轭；不要只把↑与↓的文字标签: Θ(cψ)=c*Θψ. The second application conjugates the amplitudes obtained after the first application. Merely exchanging the written ↑ and ↓ labels is insufficient.
先检验二色置换的线性和平方: Check the linearity and square of two-color exchange
交换基向量两次即回到原标签，并且P对复标量不作共轭。若母群取C₂=<s>且ρ(s: Exchanging the basis labels twice restores them, and P does not conjugate complex scalars. If the parent group is C₂=<s> with ρ(s)=P, the kernel contains only the identity and the image has 2 elements. Self-check: P(i,0)ᵀ=(0,i)ᵀ, rather than (0,−i)ᵀ, consistent with a color-preserving kernel of index 2.
按本课负号约定逐项作用Θ: Apply Θ component by component using the negative-sign convention
先共轭(a,b)，再左乘A，得到(−b*,a*)。例如Θ|↑⟩=|↓⟩，Θ|↓⟩: Conjugate (a,b), then multiply by A to obtain (−b*,a*). Thus Θ|↑⟩=|↓⟩ and Θ|↓⟩=−|↑⟩. Self-check: Θ(i|↑⟩)=−i|↓⟩, which differs in sign from iΘ|↑⟩. This tests an antilinear operator identity; an overall phase difference of an isolated state alone does not establish an observable difference.
把两次共轭写出来: Keep track of conjugation in both applications
一般公式为Θ²=AA*，本题A是实矩阵，所以AA*=A²=−I。直接对(−b*,: In general, Θ²=AA*. Here A is real, so AA*=A²=−I. Applying Θ directly to (−b*,a*) also gives (−a,−b). Self-check: P²=I and Θ²=−I both hold. Replacing A with A′=−A, as in the other demonstration's positive-sign convention, still gives A′A′*=−I.
一个复态上的巧合不能证明两个算符相同: Agreement on one complex state does not identify the operators
对ψc=(1,i)/√2，恰有Pψc=Θψc=(i,1)/√2；因此一次输入的相: For ψc=(1,i)/√2, the outputs happen to agree: Pψc=Θψc=(i,1)/√2. Agreement for one input does not determine the operator type. Self-check: For input iψc, P gives (−1,i)/√2 whereas Θ gives (1,−i)/√2, following their linear and antilinear rules. These outputs differ by an overall minus sign, so comparing their probabilities alone still cannot replace the operator test.
再找一个不靠整体相位区分的叠加态: Find a superposition whose outputs are not related by a global phase
对ψ+=(1,1)/√2，P保持该向量，而Θ送到(−1,1)/√2，两输出正交。: For ψ+=(1,1)/√2, P preserves the vector whereas Θ gives (−1,1)/√2. The outputs are orthogonal. If P is compared as σx in the same spin space, the σx expectation value remains +1 after P but becomes −1 after Θ. Self-check: The inner product between the outputs is 0, confirming that they do not differ merely by an overall phase.
用保持换色却无简并的模型检验结论: Test a model with exchange symmetry but no degeneracy
H=P满足[H,P]=0，但其两个本征值为+1和−1，各为一维，所以普通交换对称: H=P satisfies [H,P]=0, yet its eigenvalues are +1 and −1, each with a one-dimensional eigenspace. Ordinary exchange symmetry alone therefore does not enforce double degeneracy. Self-check: H(1,1)ᵀ=(1,1)ᵀ and H(1,−1)ᵀ=−(1,−1)ᵀ. Calculating ΘHΘ⁻¹=−H shows that this model lacks spin time-reversal symmetry, so it does not contradict Kramers' theorem.
写清从算符到配对还需要什么: State the additional conditions for an energy partner
对非零自旋态，⟨ψ|Θψ⟩=a*(−b*)+b*a*=0。只有哈密顿量也具有该反: For a nonzero spin state, ⟨ψ|Θψ⟩=a*(−b*)+b*a*=0. For an energy eigenstate, Θψ is an orthogonal partner at the same energy only when the Hamiltonian also has this antiunitary symmetry. Pairing at the same crystal momentum additionally requires −k and k to be equivalent modulo a reciprocal-lattice vector. Self-check: A surjective two-color map, P²=I, or matching arrow diagrams alone supplies none of these quantum conditions.
Θ²=−I，ΘHΘ⁻¹=H ⇒ ψ与Θψ同能且正交；同一k还须−k≡k: Θ²=−I, ΘHΘ⁻¹=H ⇒ energy eigenstates ψ and Θψ have equal energies and are orthogonal; same-k pairing also requires −k≡k
普通二色交换P线性且P²=I；本节自旋时间反演Θ=−iσyK反线性且Θ²=−I。: Ordinary two-color exchange P is linear and satisfies P²=I. This lesson's spin time reversal Θ=−iσyK is antilinear and satisfies Θ²=−I. Their components can agree for a particular input, yet their outputs for ψ+ are orthogonal. H=σx is an explicit model that preserves P but has distinct energies ±1; it does not preserve Θ. Kramers pairing depends on the actual antiunitary operator and the Hamiltonian's symmetry, rather than the number of labels or an exchange diagram.
两种Θ整体相位约定不会改变Θ²；没有相位参考时，孤立态整体负号也不改变概率。区分: Changing the overall phase convention for Θ does not change Θ². Without a phase reference, an overall minus sign on an isolated state does not change probabilities either. Test the transformation of complex coefficients to distinguish linear from antilinear maps; use a state such as ψ+ to obtain orthogonal outputs when comparing states. Do not automatically interpret P in a formal label space as electron time reversal in a material.
已知H=P=σx满足[H,P]=0且P²=I，对其能级可以作出哪项判断？: Given H=P=σx, with [H,P]=0 and P²=I, which statement about its energies is correct?
换色对称已经保证两个能级相等: Exchange symmetry already guarantees equal energies
两个能级可为−1与+1，普通换色不强制Kramers简并: The energies can be −1 and +1; ordinary color exchange does not enforce Kramers degeneracy
必须加入第三种颜色才能定义这个模型: A third color is required to define this model
H的特征多项式为λ²−1，两个本征值各一维；它保持P却满足ΘHΘ⁻¹=−H，故不: H has characteristic polynomial λ²−1, with a one-dimensional eigenspace for each eigenvalue. It preserves P but satisfies ΘHΘ⁻¹=−H, so it is not a counterexample to Kramers' theorem under spin time-reversal symmetry.
U(1) · 四个相位点为什么不是整个连续群？: U(1) · Why are four phase points not the full continuous group?
从 r=i 出发生成 C₄，检验 45° 相位是否属于这个子群；再解释为什么无限: Generate C₄ from r=i and test whether the 45° phase belongs to this subgroup. Then explain why infinitely many lattice translations can still form a discrete group.
U(1) 的元素为 e^(iφ)，相乘对应角度相加。: The elements of U(1) are e^(iφ); multiplication adds their phase angles.
本题 C₄={1,r,r²,r³}，r=i；一维晶格允许位移 n a，其中 a>: Here C₄={1,r,r²,r³}, with r=i. A one-dimensional lattice permits displacements n a, where a>0 and n∈ℤ.
先求四次乘方，再检查乘积的指数如何取模。讨论平移时，先寻找恒等平移附近最小的非零: Calculate the powers through the fourth power, then check how exponents combine modulo 4. For translations, identify the smallest nonzero displacement near the identity.
把 r 连乘，第四次返回恒等元。四个结果互不相同。: Multiply successive powers of r. The fourth power returns the identity, and the four preceding powers are distinct.
任意两个元素相乘，把指数对4取余仍在这四点中；逆元也由负指数取模得到。: Reduce the sum of exponents modulo 4 to see that every product remains among the four points. Inverses follow by reducing negative exponents modulo 4.
加入一个不属于子群的角度: Test an angle outside the subgroup
45° 对应 (1+i)/√2，它的模为1，但不等于四点中的任一个。U(1) 中: The 45° phase is (1+i)/√2. Its modulus is 1, but it is not one of the four points. The presence of this element in U(1) does not give a square 45° rotational symmetry.
整数平移数目无限，但任何非零位移的绝对值至少为a。位移a/1000不是允许的晶格: There are infinitely many integer translations, yet every nonzero displacement has magnitude at least a. The displacement a/1000 is not a permitted lattice translation, so there are no arbitrarily small nonzero lattice translations near zero.
C₄={1,i,−1,−i} 是 U(1) 的四元素子群；U(1) 局部需要一个: C₄={1,i,−1,−i} is a four-element subgroup of U(1). U(1) locally requires one real parameter. The integer lattice-translation group has infinitely many elements but is discrete.
反例是平移群 ℤ：元素数无限不保证连续。还要区分群阶4、U(1)的实维数1和所选: The translation group ℤ is a counterexample to the claim that infinitely many elements imply continuity. Also distinguish the group order 4, the real dimension 1 of U(1), and the size of a chosen representation matrix.
无限多个群元素就一定构成连续群: Infinitely many group elements always imply a continuous group
C₄是U(1)的子群，而无限整数平移仍可离散: C₄ is a subgroup of U(1), while infinitely many integer translations can still form a discrete group
U(1)维数为1，所以只有一个元素: U(1) has dimension 1, so it has only one element
C₄的乘积仍落在四点中；整数平移缺少任意小的非零步长。维数描述局部参数，不是元素: Products in C₄ remain among its four points. Integer translations have no arbitrarily small nonzero steps. Dimension counts local parameters, not group elements.
U(2) 与 SU(2) · 保范数还要检查什么？: U(2) and SU(2) · What must be checked beyond norm preservation?
分别判断 U=diag(e^(−iπ/4),e^(iπ/4)) 与 V=diag: Determine whether U=diag(e^(−iπ/4),e^(iπ/4)) and V=diag(i,1) belong to U(2) or SU(2). Then use a transformation that mixes basis states to examine what probability conservation means.
U(2) 要求 M†M=I₂；SU(2) 还要求 det M=1。: U(2) requires M†M=I₂; SU(2) additionally requires det M=1.
A† 表示矩阵 A 的共轭转置，同时包含转置与复共轭；|↑⟩=(1,0)ᵀ。: A† denotes the conjugate transpose of matrix A, combining transposition with complex conjugation; |↑⟩=(1,0)ᵀ.
先把两个相位写成 (1∓i)/√2，逐项做共轭转置。不要把“行列式模为1”当成“: Write the phases as (1∓i)/√2 and take the conjugate transpose entry by entry. A determinant of modulus 1 need not equal 1.
计算U的共轭转置与范数条件: Calculate U† and check norm preservation
两个对角元互为共轭且模长都为1，乘回去得到单位矩阵。: The diagonal entries are complex conjugates and each has modulus 1. Multiplying U† by U gives the identity.
U的行列式是两个共轭相位之积，所以恰好等于1。: The determinant of U is the product of two conjugate phases, so it is exactly 1.
V的每个对角元也都有单位模长，因此酉性成立；但行列式不是1。: Each diagonal entry of V also has unit modulus, so V is unitary, but its determinant is not 1.
V†V=I₂，det V=i≠1，因此 V∈U(2)，V∉SU(2): V†V=I₂ and det V=i≠1, so V∈U(2) but V∉SU(2)
保持总概率不要求保持各分量: Total probability can be preserved while component probabilities change
取 W=[[1,−1],[1,1]]/√2。W仍属于SU(2)，却把上态变成等幅: Take W=[[1,−1],[1,1]]/√2. Although W belongs to SU(2), it sends the up state to an equal-amplitude superposition. Probabilities for individual basis outcomes can therefore change.
U属于SU(2)；V属于U(2)但不属于SU(2)。酉变换保持总概率和内积，可以: U belongs to SU(2). V belongs to U(2) but not SU(2). Unitary transformations preserve total probability and inner products while allowing probabilities in a chosen basis to be redistributed.
V是“酉但不special”的明确反例；W是“总概率不变但各分量概率改变”的明确: V is unitary without satisfying the special condition. W preserves total probability while changing the component probabilities. Omitting complex conjugation gives an incorrect unitarity test.
V†V=I₂而det V=i。酉性与行列式等于1必须分别检查。: V†V=I₂, whereas det V=i. Check unitarity and the determinant-one condition separately.
生成元 · 同一个对易子为何差一个系数？: Generators · Why does the same commutator acquire a different factor?
从Pauli矩阵相乘求 [Tx,Ty]，其中 Ta=σa/2；再解释交换次序和改: Multiply the Pauli matrices to calculate [Tx,Ty], with Ta=σa/2. Then explain what changes when the order is reversed or the σ normalization is used.
[A,B]=AB−BA；本课有限变换为U(θ)=exp(−iθT)，T为厄米生成: [A,B]=AB−BA. This course uses finite transformations U(θ)=exp(−iθT), where T is a Hermitian generator.
先算σxσy和σyσx，再相减；最后才除以4，因为两个因子各带一个1/2。: Calculate σxσy and σyσx separately, then subtract. Divide by 4 afterward because each generator contributes a factor of 1/2.
直接行列相乘，两个结果的符号相反。: Direct row-by-column multiplication gives two results with opposite signs.
相减并转换归一化: Subtract and apply the generator normalization
Pauli矩阵的对易子先得到2iσz；Tx、Ty各含一个1/2，所以还需除以4。: The Pauli-matrix commutator is 2iσz. Since Tx and Ty each contain a factor of 1/2, divide this result by 4.
检查对易子和李代数约定: Check the commutator and Lie-algebra conventions
交换次序会取负。厄米生成元的对易子是反厄米矩阵；取X=−iT后才得到数学中反厄米: Reversing the order changes the sign. The commutator of Hermitian generators is anti-Hermitian. Taking X=−iT gives the anti-Hermitian Lie-algebra elements used in the mathematical convention.
一个对易对不代表整个群交换: One commuting pair does not make the group Abelian
SU(3)中的T₃、T₈都是对角矩阵，所以对易；而其嵌入的T₁、T₂仍不对易。: In SU(3), T₃ and T₈ commute because they are diagonal, whereas the embedded T₁ and T₂ do not commute.
[Tx,Ty]=iTz；改用σ矩阵时是[σx,σy]=2iσz。交换x、y会取负: [Tx,Ty]=iTz, whereas the σ-matrix convention gives [σx,σy]=2iσz. Exchanging x and y changes the sign. Keep the two normalizations distinct.
T₃和T₈对易不意味着SU(3)是阿贝尔群；同时，若把厄米T直接视为普通对易子下: The fact that T₃ and T₈ commute does not make SU(3) Abelian. Treating the Hermitian T matrices directly as a real Lie-algebra basis under the ordinary commutator also overlooks the factor of i in this convention.
两个1/2相乘给1/4，乘上[σx,σy]=2iσz，结果为iσz/2=iTz。: The two factors of 1/2 give 1/4. Multiplying [σx,σy]=2iσz by 1/4 gives iσz/2=iTz.
SU(2) · 从旋量振幅算出 Bloch 方向: SU(2) · Calculate the Bloch direction from spinor amplitudes

U(n,θ)=cos(θ/2)I₂−i sin(θ/2)n·σ；n为单位轴。: U(n,θ)=cos(θ/2)I₂−i sin(θ/2)n·σ, where n is a unit rotation axis.

路径相干、两支等幅，合束理想；除指定自旋旋转外没有附加相位、损耗或退相干。: The paths are coherent and have equal amplitudes, with ideal recombination. Apart from the specified spin rotation, there are no additional phases, losses, or decoherence.

半角分别为π和2π，正弦项都为0。两个结果对所有单位旋转轴成立。: The half-angles are π and 2π, and both sine terms vanish. The results hold for every unit rotation axis.
ρ=ψψ†中的两个负号抵消。自旋概率和Bloch向量均不变。: The two minus signs cancel in ρ=ψψ†, leaving spin probabilities and the Bloch vector unchanged.

a支不变，b支取负，原来的同号路径组合变成异号组合。: Arm a is unchanged while arm b changes sign, converting the sum of path amplitudes into their difference.
比较合束概率和共同旋转: Compare output probabilities with a rotation on both arms
单支旋转后只有−端口；两支都旋转则联合态整体取负，仍只有+端口。: Rotating one arm populates only the − port. Rotating both arms changes the overall sign of the joint state, leaving only the + port populated.
单支2π：P+=0，P−=1；两支2π：P+=1，P−=0: One arm rotated by 2π: P+=0, P−=1; both arms rotated by 2π: P+=1, P−=0
理想相干条件下，仅一支经历2π会将+端口切换到−端口；孤立自旋或两支共同获得整体: Under the ideal coherent conditions specified here, a 2π rotation on only one arm switches the output from the + port to the − port. An overall minus sign on an isolated spin, or on both arms together, does not change the readout.
反例是两支同时乘−1：不能把整体负号说成端口改变。这里检验相对相位，不把时间反演: Multiplying both arms by −1 is a counterexample: an overall minus sign does not switch the output port. This exercise tests relative phase; it does not treat time reversal as an ordinary SU(2) rotation.
只在b支施加2π旋转后，理想−端口概率是？: After a 2π rotation only on arm b, what is the ideal −-port probability?
联合态变成|−⟩path⊗ψ，投影到−端口的范数平方为1。该结论使用本题的等幅、: The joint state becomes |−⟩path⊗ψ. Its projection onto the − port has squared norm 1, using the equal-amplitude, coherence, and ideal-recombination assumptions of this exercise.

SU(2)自旋j不可约表示的维数为2j+1；D^(j)(−I)=(−1)^(2j: The spin-j irreducible representation of SU(2) has dimension 2j+1, with D^(j)(−I)=(−1)^(2j)I.

先分别代入j，再用共轭作用检查−I对三个Pauli方向的实际作用。一个表示可以把: Substitute the two values of j, then check the conjugation action of −I on the three Pauli directions. A representation can send a nonidentity group element to the identity matrix.
同一SU(2)群有不同作用空间；维数由表示标签j决定。: The same group SU(2) can act on different spaces. The representation label j determines the space's dimension.

数出三阶无迹厄米矩阵的独立实参数，再用T₁=λ₁/2推导e₁初态在π、2π、4π: Count the independent real parameters of a traceless Hermitian 3×3 matrix. Then use T₁=λ₁/2 to derive the transformation of an initial e₁ state at parameter angles π, 2π, and 4π.
